package external.nodus.compat;

import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.NodusProject;
import edu.uclouvain.core.nodus.database.gui.SQLConsole;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

/** Compiled against SQLConsole before the internal split, never rebuilt by the tests. */
public final class LegacySQLConsole extends SQLConsole {
  public int prompts;
  public int resets;
  public boolean promptOnEdt;

  public LegacySQLConsole(NodusProject project) {
    super(project, false);
  }

  @Override
  protected int showOverwriteDialog(String message) {
    prompts++;
    promptOnEdt = SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread();
    return JOptionPane.NO_OPTION;
  }

  @Override
  public void resetScript() {
    resets++;
    super.resetScript();
  }

  public boolean batch(String[] commands) {
    return super.runBatch(commands);
  }

  public void close() {
    super.windowClosing(null);
  }
}
